summary: Executed ADDITIONAL native Electron smoke only (Linux arm64 under manual Xvfb) using isolated desktop copy and MOCKED stand-in page (privacy_url -> /api/health in test copy only). UI login succeeded and TEMP_NATIVE fixture sidebar click succeeded, but critical native registration/open pipeline failed.

critical.issue: Returns 401 'Entre na sua conta para continuar.' from Electron main session.fetch after successful UI login (/api/auth/me=200). Blocks device approval, lease acquisition, and WebContentsView open.

ui_bugs.issue: close-native-browser remains disabled because native state never leaves 'Navegador fechado'.

integration_issues.flow: Desktop register -> open creator via WebContentsView
integration_issues.issue: No active lease, no health-page WebContents, no creator partition observed in main process because register keeps failing 401.

action_items: Fix Electron control-session auth propagation so /api/desktop/devices/register sees the same authenticated session as renderer after login.
After register works, retest lease open path: WebContentsView URL load (/api/health stand-in), non-zero bounds, isolated partition, and native close/unmount/logout lifecycle.
Keep production desktop files unchanged; stand-in substitution must remain test-copy-only.
critical_code_review_comments: Main process uses session.fromPartition('persist:alta-control') with session.fetch(credentials:'include'), but observed behavior indicates cookie/token not present in that request path during native runtime.
Backend logs during run repeatedly show /api/desktop/devices/register 401 while concurrent /api/auth/me is 200, confirming a cross-context auth gap rather than invalid manager credentials.
Because register failed, downstream validations (WebContentsView composition, preload isolation checks on stand-in page, lease heartbeat lifecycle) could not be fully validated.

rca of the issue: Repro: launch isolated Electron app under Xvfb, login via UI, call altaDesktop.register() -> backend returns 401; then open TEMP_NATIVE sidebar profile stays 'Navegador fechado', no lease in /api/creators, no health WebContents in main process. Evidence: backend.out log lines show repeated POST /api/desktop/devices/register 401 interleaved with GET /api/auth/me 200. Likely root cause is auth cookie/session not available to Electron control session.fetch context (partition/cookie scope propagation issue). Mitigation direction: instrument cookies in main process for persist:alta-control before register, verify vertice_session path/samesite/secure visibility for session.fetch, and ensure register call happens only after authenticated cookie is present in control session.
